name: Salon pod
description: Salon pods were detachable pods used for diplomatic meetings, and were situated on Consular-class space cruisers and Republic frigates. On standard Consular-class cruisers, the pod was located directly underneath the bridge, and was completely shielded from surveillance and armored against attack. The pods possessed a holoprojector, conference table, and its circumference was lined with couches.

data.name: Salon pod
data.role: Detachable pod for diplomatic meetings or in the event of emergencies
